name: Blacktide Coral Core
description: A dense black coral grown in abyssal pressure beds.
specialEffects: Used in reef-forged blades, sea-worn edges, and abyssal fittings.

steps: Refine raw stock for Blacktide Coral Core under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Blacktide Refinery protocol before storage.
